WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT
    LEFT(o.customer_id, 10) AS customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders
  FROM orders o
  GROUP BY LEFT(o.customer_id, 10)
),
customer_seller_order_counts AS (
  SELECT
    LEFT(o.customer_id, 10) AS customer_id,
    oi.seller_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_from_seller
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY LEFT(o.customer_id, 10), oi.seller_id
),
customer_flags AS (
  SELECT
    coc.customer_id,
    coc.total_orders,
    -- whether customer placed more than one order in total
    (coc.total_orders > 1) AS has_multiple_orders,
    -- whether there exists at least one seller from whom the customer placed >1 orders
    (MAX(csoc.orders_from_seller) > 1) AS has_multiple_orders_same_seller
  FROM customer_order_counts coc
  LEFT JOIN customer_seller_order_counts csoc
    ON coc.customer_id = csoc.customer_id
  GROUP BY coc.customer_id, coc.total_orders
)
SELECT
  v.customer_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cf.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM customer_flags cf
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    ('Customers with >1 total orders', cf.has_multiple_orders),
    ('Customers with >1 orders from same seller', cf.has_multiple_orders_same_seller)
) AS v(customer_group, flag)
WHERE v.flag
GROUP BY v.customer_group
ORDER BY v.customer_group;
